correctness.rationale: From F_x=yQ, F_y=xQ and F_z=x^3+xyQ_z+G_z, smoothness off Q=0 follows from squarefreeness of G. At each of two simple Q-roots, h_r has three distinct algebraic zeros. Its nonzero derivative yields regular parameters t,s,u with exact completed equation ts+u^3=0 (A2), and resolving three A2 points on a triple residual line yields the affine E6 multiplicities of IV*. Six other residual cubics have isolated ordinary-node quadratics. ℓ maps as Frobenius degree three. Independently over F9, Q has two simple roots and h_r has no common root with its derivative (critical x=1 at each); this certifies nonempty hypotheses but not the universal theorem.
